source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "land acquisition" OR "land pooling" OR "special economic zone" OR "land grab" AND urban
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"land acquisition" OR "land pooling" OR "special economic zone" OR "land grab" AND urban,is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("land acquisition" OR "land pooling" OR "special economic zone" OR ("land grab" AND "urban"))
